description: Asana is a work management platform for organizing goals, projects, tasks, and workflows across teams. It also provides AI and developer features for integrating with the Asana Work Graph and workspace data.
summary: Asana exposes a REST API at `https://app.asana.com/api/1.0` authenticated by personal access tokens or OAuth 2.0, plus an OAuth-protected streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://mcp.asana.com/v2/mcp`.
